codeReview.summary: The worker successfully wired the persistence methods into the TokenAccountant lifecycle. A DEFAULT_PERSISTENCE_PATH pointing to .claude/context/metrics/token-usage.json was correctly added. The constructor auto-loads existing state, and recordUsage() auto-persists updates safely using a try-catch block to prevent metric failures from bubbling up to the main logic. Test cases were thoughtfully updated to use isolated temporary file paths to avoid pollution.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Worker initially tried to run targeted tests using 'pnpm test:framework --testPathPattern="token-accountant"' which timed out. This suggests a knowledge gap that 'pnpm test' wraps the native node test runner and doesn't support jest-style filter arguments directly, requiring 'node --test <path>' instead.
